task.title: Deploy and verify the queue coverage reconciliation timer

issue.title: Deploy and run the queue coverage reconciliation from #7016

payload.problem: PR #7697 shipped queue-coverage-reconcile.service/.timer and the /coverage client, but the first-run acceptance was pending deployment. Current user unit is not found/inactive, and no first report is recorded.
evidence: PR #7697 body records that the repo-shipped units were not installed and the running broker returned unknown command /coverage.
Current readback: systemctl --user is-enabled queue-coverage-reconcile.timer -> not-found; is-active -> inactive.
No existing open issue or queued pilot task for deployment/first-run verification was found.
acceptance: The active broker endpoint supports the /coverage call used by check_coverage.py; transport/broker failures remain explicit errors.
The declared service/timer are installed and enabled, with the existing hourly persistent schedule and registry entry intact.

Run check_coverage.py in observe mode across the four pilot repositories; import uncovered items with the sanctioned CLI path when needed, then verify a zero-uncovered report or an explicit remaining state with live task coverage.
Save the first verified report and read back the timer enabled/active state.

include: Broker /coverage availability for the active queue
exclude: Changing queue coverage semantics or filter rules
Adding a second schedule outside the existing registry entry

tests: python3 -I scripts/fleet/queue-reconcile/check_coverage.py --observe --state-dir <temporary-directory> validates end-to-end against the broker; verify systemctl --user is-enabled and is-active queue-coverage-reconcile.timer after installation.
payload.priority_reason: The sole reconciliation path has not been installed or demonstrated; without the first run, open issues may still lack live queue coverage.

dedupe.basis: No live issue or task for the queue coverage timer installation and first run was found; #7016 remains the completed design/code tracker but its acceptance was not verified in the live environment.
